notes.title: [5/16/25] - Patch Notes (Ghost Replays)
notes.content:
After two weeks of development I am proud to announce a major feature to PreStrafe!

[h2]Ghost Replays[/h2]

[list]
[*] Replays are recorded everytime your time trial starts or resets automatically
[*] Keeps track of all of your locations, rotations, animations, and Steam ID
[*] Stored securely and automatically online for upload/download, keeping only your best record
[*] Leaderboards now have an "eyecon" for each user that has an available ghost replay, toggle on and off independently
[*] Replays are only uploaded upon achieving a better record (ask to remove your record)
[*] Each ghost that you spawn has a random generated color for ease of visibility
[/list]

[previewyoutube=mlBda-WqBkc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: [4/15/25] - Patch Notes (Movement Update)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New tech: slope-roll-boost (SRB for short) and slope-flip-boost (SFB)
[*] Enabled walljumping from flipping and vice versa
[*] Added dynamic friction based on player velocity (higher speed = less friction)
[*] Added dynamic air acceleration based on player velocity (higher speed = greater accel)
[*] Might've fixed differing client vs server speed/acceleration
[*] Reduced time from landing to enable dive
[*] Reduced air acceleration for flip
[*] Minor animation transition improvements between states
[*] Changed speedometer to read only horizontal velocity
[*] Set menu buttons audio to sound classes
[*] Reduced wind audio volume
[*] Added noclip detection during a time trial
[*] Added booster to level editor
[*] Doors now close upon resetting trial (doors can be used extensively now)
[*] Fixed up collision when placing lights and special actors
[/list]

In order to perform SRB or SFB you need to be going fast enough upon hitting a slope, you will want to perform the dive (into roll) or flip as soon as you hit the slope for maximum effect. Doing an SRB will reset your walljumps and allow full air acceleration.

notes.title: [3/5/25] - Level Editor & Workshop Support
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added built-in level editor, levels save locally to [b]/PreStrafe/CustomLevels/[/b]
[*] Added workshop support for custom levels
[*] Host servers on custom levels (may not download them automatically yet)
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3414800/workshop/]Workshop[/url] here.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
The current version of the level editor has limited options, this build serves as a test for functionality of creating, uploading, and playing on servers with custom levels.

[h3]Workshop Upload[/h3]
To upload your level it's very important to fill in every textbox or else the workshop item will fail to upload successfully. The file paths should look something like below, except [b]without quotes[/b]! Be sure to add your image to the same directory as your level.

[h3]Path Examples[/h3]
[table]
[tr]
[td]Level Path:[/td]
[th]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\PreStrafePlaytest\PreStrafe\CustomLevels\Test\Test.level[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Image Path:[/td]
[th]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\PreStrafePlaytest\PreStrafe\CustomLevels\Test\Test.jpg[/th]
[/tr]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/TBswTLxx/Unreal-Editor-08if-QUWxo-M.png[/img]
